atoms.text: This level includes mentions of uncomfortable situations both at school and at home. If this level upsets you, you should speak with a trusted adult about it.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

feedback.finish: Your friends should not be putting pressure on you to do something you’re not comfortable with. If you say no, your friends should not try to make you change your mind.

atoms.text: Jordan’s friends are going on a secret camping trip in the forest without telling their parents. He says he doesn’t want to join in because it’s unsafe, but they insist that they want him there.

atoms.a: Why is this an uncomfortable situation? Select the two correct answers.
b: ++Jordan’s friends are putting him under pressure to do something he finds unsafe.
++Jordan’s friends aren’t respecting it when he doesn’t give consent.
Jordan’s friends are breaking his trust by sharing his secrets.

atoms.a: What should Jordan do? Select the two correct answers.
b: ++He should firmly say no and refuse to join in.
++He should tell his parents he’s feeling uncomfortable.
He should go along with it to make his friends happy.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

feedback.finish: Although you should generally keep people’s secrets, sometimes it’s better to break their trust and tell an adult, such as when they are doing something wrong.

atoms.text: Millie’s friends have been bullying one of their classmates. She doesn’t take part in it, but she’s also afraid to stop them. They tell her it’s a secret and that she’s not allowed to tell anyone.

atoms.a: Why is this an uncomfortable situation? Select the two correct answers.
b: ++Millie is afraid to break her friends’ trust by sharing their secret.
++Millie doesn’t want to do anything without her friends’ consent.
Millie has too many friends to choose between.

atoms.a: What should Millie do? Select the two correct answers.
b: ++She should realise it’s better to break her friends’ trust in this case.
++She should tell a teacher.
She should respect their wishes and let the bullying continue.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

feedback.finish: If your friends share your secrets without your consent, you should tell them it’s not okay. If they don’t listen, you should rethink how much you can trust them with your secrets.

atoms.text: Raphael tells his best friend everything, including all of his private secrets. However, he’s recently found out that his best friend has been telling other people all his secrets without asking him first.

atoms.a: Why is this an uncomfortable situation? Select the two correct answers.
b: ++Raphael’s friend is breaking his trust by sharing his secrets.
++Raphael’s friend is doing something that affects him without his consent.
Raphael’s friend is putting him under pressure to do better in school.

atoms.a: What should Raphael do? Select the two correct answers.
b: ++He should approach his friend and tell him that his actions are not okay.
++He should tell his friend to ask for his consent first before doing anything that affects him.
He should get into a fight with his friend to show him he’s not happy.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

feedback.finish: You should always tell an adult if your friend has told you something worrying. You shouldn’t have to be left feeling so worried - it should be an adult dealing with this.

atoms.text: Chioma’s friend has told her that her brother has been hurting her at home. Her friend made her promise not to tell anyone, but Chioma is very worried about her and doesn’t know what to do.

atoms.a: Why is this an uncomfortable situation? Select the two correct answers.
b: ++Chioma feels under pressure to keep her friend’s secret.
++Chioma doesn’t know what the best thing to do is.
Chioma doesn’t want to stay friends with this friend anymore.

atoms.a: What should Chioma do? Select the two correct answers.
b: ++She should tell an adult so they can do something to help.
++She should realise it would keep her friend safe to tell someone her secret.
She should keep her promise and stay quiet about this.
